topic: FLNG Hilli Episeyo end of Cameroon charter and redeployment to Argentina
wiki_text: The FLNG Hilli Episeyo's charter offshore Kribi, Cameroon (with Perenco Cameroon and Société Nationale des Hydrocarbures) runs to the third quarter of 2026. In December 2024 Golar LNG acquired the remaining minority interests in the vessel (from Seatrium, successor to Keppel Offshore & Marine, and from Black & Veatch), becoming the 100% owner of the 2.4 mtpa unit, effective ~1 January 2025. In 2025 Golar signed a 20-year charter to redeploy Hilli Episeyo offshore Argentina (Gulf of San Matías) for Southern Energy S.A. (SESA), backed by Pan American Energy and partners. Per Golar's Q1 2026 results, a contractor was appointed in Q2 2026 to disconnect Hilli from its Cameroon mooring in July 2026 and tow it to Seatrium's Singapore yard for life-extension upgrades; the vessel is expected to recommence operations in Argentina from 2027. Golar declined to extend the Cameroon contract, citing a capacity cap limiting earnings, so Cameroon FLNG production is expected to cease in 2026 absent a replacement vessel.
